name: phase10e-proxy-human-gold-v0.1
purpose: Operating-Regime Adequacy proxy Human Gold, frozen before measurement
delegation_note: User explicitly delegated an initial Human-Gold pass to the assistant on 2026-09-16; labels are provisional and auditable, not claimed as direct user annotations.
gating_policy: Main-regime cases are gating for provisional 10E closure. Rare/synthetic corner cases are excluded and remain flywheel watch items.

cases.rationale: Ordinary reinforcement updates awareness but does not deserve delegated monitoring or interruption.
An important active question benefits from continued machine responsibility, but reinforcement alone does not justify immediate interruption.
A bottleneck is decision-relevant, but weak evidence should be kept under watch rather than forcing deep attention.
A well-supported challenge to important committed cognition deserves immediate review.
An important but weakly supported challenge should be verified and monitored without immediate interruption.
A genuinely new, important, well-supported branch inside RAOS jurisdiction can justify immediate attention.
An important new branch with weak support should preserve future option value through WATCH, not immediate deep attention.
A normally ENGAGE-grade item can be deferred when the user is under a tight deadline and interruption is costly.
Material in-domain world awareness can be worth seeing even without a cognitive-state transition.
Without cognitive change, non-material evidence should not consume human-visible attention merely because attention momentum exists.
